title: CSTNet: A Dual-Branch Convolutional Neural Network for Imaging of Reactive Flows Using Chemical Species Tomography
summary: CSTNet reconstructs species concentration and temperature from chemical-species tomography. The paper reports improved accuracy and noise robustness on simulated data and measured real-flame experiments using a low-complexity optical sensor; broader transfer to other processes is not established.
ai_technology: CSTNet, a dual-branch convolutional neural network using tomography measurements and sensor layout
organization: Not stated in the reviewed author manuscript

evidence.tested: CSTNet reconstructed concentration and temperature fields more accurately and robustly than comparison methods, including measured real-flame data.
evidence.unknown: Simulated and experimental flame evaluation is reported; transfer to other flow settings is not shown.
evidence.ai_role: A dual-branch CNN jointly reconstructs concentration and temperature fields from chemical-species tomography measurements and sensor layout.
